Five merged PRs since 2026-04-16 on the main line added or removed a line containing `voidedValue` under `src`. The pinned head is `8f4fd2677aae1d8a8c522f710059b0f26b22d4bb` (v5.0.0), and all five merge commits are ancestors of it.

1. **#822** (O3-6030), merged 2026-10-02 18:57 UTC, commit `ebb02b719931d121419669b531b6e05c77f515e9`. It changes `voidedValue` lines in `src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.ts`: the `prepareOrders` and `prepareDiagnosis` mappings (around lines 296–298 and 434–437 now) were rewritten to be hidden-aware.
2. **#826** (O3-6027), merged 2026-10-05 11:52 UTC, commit `0e1edc234479890d45bc09e67b2ee25befc1c803`. `src/adapters/encounter-diagnosis-adapter.test.ts:206` changed its `voidedValue` assertion from `toBe(undefined)` to `toBeNull()`.
3. **#842** (O3-5847), merged 2026-10-13 10:47 UTC, commit `b0d8fd2e9a0c68f2c72b2415b6dbf351b6e92c30`. It adds `voidedValue` assertions in the new "values fed back after loading" block of `src/adapters/obs-adapter.test.ts` (roughly lines 1535–1925).
4. **#812**, merged 2026-09-22 19:51 UTC, commit `ae1b2b294c2e1a7635bb05f9ed803d7a769496f4`. It adds `voidedValue` lines in the new `src/provider/form-factory-helper.test.ts` (lines 49 and 57) and in `src/processors/encounter/encounter-form-processor.test.ts` (line 34).
5. **#787**, merged 2026-08-20 19:59 UTC, commit `a6f911cf3612608cac9649229396e0ebc92ae8ba`. It adds the new `src/processors/encounter/encounter-payloads.golden.test.ts` (which contains `voidedValue`, e.g. lines 551, 1524, 1531) and adds `voidedValue` helper lines to `src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.test.ts` (lines 39–41, 360–361).

Ticket keys named by these PRs: O3-6030 (#822), O3-6027 (#826), O3-5847 (#842). #812 and #787 name no ticket.

Coverage: I checked the diffs of the in-window PRs that touch the ten `src` files containing `voidedValue`, plus several others (#670, #726, #728, #742, #756, #759, #784, #800, #824, #838, #840, #843). I did not diff every in-window PR; dependency bumps and a few small ones (#729, #733, #734, #767, #779, #537, #740) were not individually examined for `voidedValue` lines.
